answer: In elder-care credentialing, each caregiver identity is bound to a verifiable onyx-anchored attestation chain recording continuous service history, so a sybil cluster cannot fabricate the longitudinal care record a real worker accumulates. Cross-institutional verification propagates a ripple of trust scores across the mesa of registered provider nodes, forcing each new. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
